entities.name: Manuchehri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Najm Aḥmad ibn Qauṣ ibn Aḥmad Manūčihrī, a.k.a. Manuchehri Dāmghānī, was an eleventh-century court poet in Persia and in the estimation of J. W. Clinton, 'the third and last of the major panegyrists of the early Ghaznawid court'. Among his poems is "The Turkish harpist".
